name: rea-local
description: A Windows local plugin for the REA MCP server and evidence-based reverse-engineering workflow.

interface.longDescription: Use REA's existing local MCP server and evidence workflows to inspect binaries, JavaScript and Electron applications, managed assemblies, and supported runtime behavior. This Windows configuration requires a local MCP-capable host and existing analysis prerequisites.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this local application with REA and explain the feature using evidence.
Compare these two local artifacts and identify the relevant behavioral changes.
